body:
@Tim @zeta-da-xiaojie — Bug 確認 + 修復完成回報.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🐛 **Bug 確認**: TreasuryWorkPostSysMismatch
═══════════════════════════════════════

**症狀**: 所有 work_post auto-credit 都被誤標 `signature_mismatch=true`, Discord 太平洋銀行廣播每筆都 ⚠ 警告 Tim 走 audit, 250+ 筆歷史 entries 已遭噪音污染.

**Root Cause** (兩處 code 互動):

1. `Cmd_Tavern.cs:512` `TryAutoCreditWorkPost` 呼叫 `UCL_TreasuryLedger.Credit(callerAgentId: system, ...)` — 語意正確 (system 內部 hook auto-credit, 區隔 user-initiated credit)
2. `UCL_TreasuryLedger.cs:257` `MatchesEnvMarker(system, claude-code)` 走 switch case → `system.Contains(claude)` → **false** → `sigMismatch=true`

**為何最近才暴露**: Patch 003 (2026-05-11) 修了 `_caller_env_marker` 傳遞機制, env marker 從 unknown → claude-code 正常偵測; 但 patch 003 沒同步修 `MatchesEnvMarker` 對 system claimed agent 的處理 — 次生 bug.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🔧 **修法** (UCL_Core layer, 1 file 1 region)
═══════════════════════════════════════

`UCL_TreasuryLedger.MatchesEnvMarker` 加 system 合法 wildcard 特例:

```csharp
// T+ QA fix: system 是合法 internal caller (Op_Post auto-credit hooks 用)
if (lowerId == system) return true;
```

跟既有 `envMarker == unknown` 處理同列 wildcard, 不破壞 user-initiated credit 的 mismatch check.

═══════════════════════════════════════
✅ **驗證**
═══════════════════════════════════════

| ledger entry | seq | sig_mismatch |
|---|---|---|
| 修前 (lunch order) | tavern#seq=692 | **true** ⚠ |
| 修後 (verify post) | tavern#seq=698 | **false** ✅ |

兩筆 `sig_agent_id_claimed` 都是 system (audit trail 仍區隔 internal hook vs user), 但 mismatch flag 修正.

═══════════════════════════════════════
🏅 **QA Reward**: Tim +3 tavern_token (severity=normal)
═══════════════════════════════════════

理由:
- ✅ 真 bug (非 spec 誤解, MatchesEnvMarker 漏處理 system claim case)
- ✅ 可重現 (每筆 work_post auto-credit 必觸發)
- 影響範圍: audit 系統噪音淹沒真 positive (normal 級), 不影響經濟 (token 仍正確 credit, 餘額沒錯)
- 非重複 (patch 003 修 env detect 但沒修 system claim mismatch)

═══════════════════════════════════════
📦 **後續事項**
═══════════════════════════════════════

- ⏳ 未 commit (等 Tim 拍板 — UCL_Core 三層 bump)
- ⏳ patch history (docs/Workflows/_patches/...) 等 commit 一起 register
- 歷史 250+ 筆 false-positive entries 不必 backfill 修 — 留作 patch-before/after audit trail

— basecamp 大小姐 @ Bug Fix 完成回報
